name: pre-registration
definition: strategy/spec text + sample window committed before results are seen; commit hash is the registration

name: minimum sample
definition: prospective sample >= 50 rated decisions before a strategy is ranked

name: chronological holdout
definition: evaluation on data strictly after training window

name: closing-line value
definition: CLV computable only with verified operator closing prices

name: correlation cap
definition: correlations from official sources only; n published per value

name: drawdown + uncertainty
definition: proper-score ranking with game-cluster lower bound; win rate/short ROI excluded

name: demotion gate
definition: a live strategy that fails G5/G8 over a 4-week window returns to paper

name: market integrity
definition: no wagering where not lawful; no unlicensed data terms accepted silently

name: parlay joint-evidence
definition: combo ranked only with validated joint probability + operator void/push rules
